numbers: 离寒假约三周；Danvers 一家去阿鲁巴

facts.fact: 数天互避 Jonathan；校园变战场：不让目光相遇、无电话、无晚餐
facts.anchor: The campus transformed into a battlefield.
facts.verbatim: The campus transformed into a battlefield.

facts.fact: Danvers 传唤让她出汗；若 Jonathan 背叛怎么办——连 Harriot 都不敢告知（要面对她眼中的审判）
facts.anchor: face the judgment in her eyes
facts.verbatim: face the judgment in her eyes

facts.fact: Harriot 有魅力自信能翻身、有 plausible deniability、没有档案馆钥匙——「我却是押上一切」
Harper 不在惯常位置；她才想起该谢她——那封让她暴怒、进洞、获手稿的信
facts.anchor: the one that had sent me into a rage
facts.verbatim: the one that had sent me into a rage

facts.fact: 「你大概知道为何找你」——她全彩幻象：保安闯档案馆、粗暴对待羊皮纸、残页攥在拳里
facts.anchor: campus security busting into the archive
facts.verbatim: campus security busting into the archive

facts.fact: 真正原因是寒假看管人；她松口气
她接任档案员（首位女性）时兴奋自愿留守——还没喝够你的房子、呼吸你呼吸过的木香
facts.anchor: the first woman to fill the position
facts.verbatim: the first woman to fill the position

facts.fact: Danvers 每年做样子请示；今天桌上无明显善意；给的津贴同去年；嘴角哀伤地扭曲
facts.anchor: there was a mournful twist in his mouth
facts.verbatim: there was a mournful twist in his mouth

facts.fact: 窗外官邸：奶油百叶窗、修剪玫瑰篱；她能认出童年卧室的窗（框着红花）——多年没进那房子
facts.anchor: I hadn’t been inside that house, my house, in years
facts.verbatim: I hadn’t been inside that house, my house, in years

facts.fact: 「我们去阿鲁巴」「圣诞节大家都感谢上帝赐了 Celia Kiel」；她想尖叫这是荣誉
facts.anchor: We all thank God for Celia Kiel come Christmastime
facts.verbatim: We all thank God for Celia Kiel come Christmastime

facts.fact: 「Harper 不再在这里工作」「我被迫解雇她」——她读出真相：是她迫他；被抛入寒冬；怒意滚下脸颊
facts.anchor: Mrs. Harper no longer works here
facts.verbatim: Mrs. Harper no longer works here
